messages:
Maya (CSM): heads up — CloverTech flagged last month’s SLO report, asking for clarity on uptime and latency hits. planning a call tomorrow with AM + eng.
Ethan (AM): got it. are the numbers ready? they want the explanation before renewal convo next week. :grimacing:
Ravi (SRE): pulled the metrics. high-level: monthly uptime = 99.87% (SLO 99.95%), p95 latency = 920ms (SLO 800ms). single downtime ~12m on 2026-02-12 due to upstream storage failover. two separate latency spikes tied to a problematic model rollout.
Maya (CSM): thanks. their contract has credit tiers — need recommendation on whether to auto-apply credits or propose mitigation + service credit.
Priya (Product): from product side: one rollout used a heavier model variant by mistake; we rolled back within 3h but that caused the p95 blip. storage failover root cause is known and patched.
Ethan (AM): contract clause: "if monthly uptime < 99.90% then 10% service credit; < 99.80% then 25%". we’re at 99.87, so falls in 10% band. they’ll expect the math and a remediation plan.
Maya (CSM): can we confirm exact credit amount? needs to be in $ and percent for billing team.
Ravi (SRE): rough calc: their monthly invoice is $120k. 10% credit => $12k. I can produce the precise SLA calculation and window breakdown.
slo-bot: automated report attached: /reports/clovertech/2026-02-slo-summary.csv
Priya (Product): recommend offering the 10% credit but package it with a technical <30-day action plan + a free enablement session to accelerate onboarding. reduces churn risk at renewal.
Ethan (AM): agree. we should also include a short FAQ doc explaining what happened and how we’ll prevent recurrence. That helps exec stakeholders.
Maya (CSM): onboarding impact — CloverTech still in Launch stage; only 40% of seats activated. they cited latency as reason for slow roll. offering paid credits + enablement could move them to GA and reduce renewal risk.
Ravi (SRE): action items for eng: 1) provide incident timeline and RCA (owner: Ravi) 2) list of mitigations deployed and planned (owner: Ravi/Priya) 3) exact token/region-level latency breakdown (owner: Ravi). ETA EOD tomorrow.
Maya (CSM): customer-facing wording draft: 
```
We sincerely apologize for the service degradation in Feb. Root causes: storage failover and an unintended model rollout. We are issuing a 10% service credit for Feb and have deployed fixes and additional guardrails. Next steps: scheduled enablement workshop, increased observability dashboards, and a rollback policy to prevent recurrence.
```
Ethan (AM): tiny edits then send. Add the credit $ amount and a note about how to apply the credit to the next invoice.
Priya (Product): also include: we’ll add a canary gating step for every model variant rollout and automated latency alarms tied to p95 thresholds.
Maya (CSM): I'll draft the email and share in this thread for review. quick ask to Billing: @ethan — can you confirm credit workflow so I can tell the customer when it will appear on their statement? :pray:
Ethan (AM): billing confirms internal workflow: credit will be applied to next invoice, appears as "Service Credit (SLA)" line item. no separate refund.
Maya (CSM): perfect. final checklist before send: incident timeline + RCA (Ravi), credit amount confirmed (Ethan), customer-facing message (Maya), enablement scheduling (Maya). aim to send tomorrow morning.
Ravi (SRE): will drop the timeline + SQL used to compute uptime into the thread: 
```
-- uptime calc
SELECT 1 - SUM(downtime_seconds)::float / (COUNT(period_seconds) * period_seconds) as uptime
FROM service_uptime_windows
WHERE customer_id = 'clovertech' AND month = '2026-02';
```
Maya (CSM): awesome. thanks all. will post draft in 1 hour for quick review. :thumbsup:
Ethan (AM): if we can attach the post-mortem and the patch notes, should be good.
Priya (Product): I'll add the canary gating ticket to the customer roadmap and share the ticket id in the email.
Maya (CSM): noted — moving to prep. low-key renewal risk but this is fixable with the combined credit + enablement approach.
slo-bot: reminder: schedule follow-up sync in two weeks with CloverTech to review post-fix metrics. :calendar:
